items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: Grandpa often told us about those guys.

ctx.x: You see, there's a lot of things that skips my memory, you know? Big I, Lloyd. He's got a good memory. He can refresh my memory.
Chris, uh... Chris Kelly, probably. Chris Kelly. Chris Kelly. They worked together. Grandpa often told us about those guys.
I knew Big I, Lloyd. I made some records of him once before he died in 1949. A couple weeks after I was part of this band once and issued some of the records.
